notes.title: AER Memories of Old - Update 1.0.4 - English
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0.4[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would freeze on specific cutscenes.
[*]Fixed an issue where text would be displayed outside of the screen in German.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player would get stuck on some geometry.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player sometimes would get stuck in an infinite respawn loop.
[*]Fixed an issue where the player wouldn't be able to transform into a bird even though the related tutorial step was completed.
[*]Fixed several issues related to audio not playing at all, or not receiving intended effects.
[*]Fixed an issue where sound would play on full volume regardless of user preferences.
[*]Fixed an issue where geometry would be in the air when it shouldn't be.
[*]Improved feedback on several progression-related hints.
[*]Improved character controls on specific parts of some islands.
[*]Fixed an issue where particles that are meant for human form would get stuck in bird form.
[*]Tutorial now auto completes after changing zones.
[/list]
